steps: open SQLite and apply required pragmas
validate schema migration checksums and execute pending forward migrations
reset interrupted outbox processing jobs to pending without adding a delivery failure
reconcile Runs, Attempts, claims, staged effects and Workflow projections
append recovery events and enqueue required idempotent outbox jobs
startupGate.singleWorkflowInvariantFailure: mark only that Workflow failed with a versioned incident and continue

queued.precondition: valid nonterminal Attempt, matching persistent claim and dispatch outbox exist; model has not started
queued.action: keep the same Run and requeue dispatch

running.action: Run and Attempt fail with process_lost, staged effects are discarded, claim is released, scheduler may create a new Attempt
running.newAttempt: only when Workflow state and remaining Task budget allow

completed_attempt_nonterminal.precondition: full immutable result snapshot exists and execution transcript is available
completed_attempt_nonterminal.action: requeue deterministic finalize_attempt for the same Attempt

terminal_attempt_nonterminal_task.action: reconcile Task projection from the terminal Attempt transaction evidence; invariant mismatch creates a Workflow incident

cancelled_or_superseded.action: preserve terminal state; discard staged effects; release matching claim; late results are audit-only

lateResult.action: terminal CAS fails; append Run and Workflow late-result audit events; never publish effects or revive state

claimRecovery.validSingleActiveAttemptMissingClaim: restore the exact WorkflowAttemptClaim and append workflow_attempt_claim_restored

stagedEffectRecovery.attemptSucceeded: all referenced effects must already be published in the same terminal transaction
stagedEffectRecovery.attemptFailedCancelledOrSuperseded: mark all remaining staged effects discarded
stagedEffectRecovery.partialPublication: fail Workflow with invariant_violation; never publish the remainder outside a repaired transaction

missingBeforePublication.action: fail Attempt, discard effects and consume Attempt budget

missingAfterPublication.action: keep immutable published facts; emit execution_transcript_missing
missingAfterPublication.readiness: Consistency error while current Required Artifact provenance depends on the missing transcript
repair: execute a new Task that produces successor revisions with complete provenance

databaseFailures.transactionError: rollback leaves no partial state/event/receipt/outbox; return 500 and allow the same commandId or dedupe key to retry
databaseFailures.commitOutcomeUnknown: read command receipt or target CAS state before retrying
databaseFailures.foreignKeyOrCheckViolation: rollback and create a technical incident only when the originating durable operation can be identified

dispatch_run.onExhausted: Run and Attempt fail with dispatch_failed; consume one Attempt budget total

finalize_attempt.onExhausted: Workflow fails with outbox_exhausted incident; preserve completed Run/result for retry-recovery

abort_run.onExhausted: append abort_delivery_failed warning; governed target remains terminal and late result is discarded

outbox.processingOnRestart: reset to pending without incrementing delivery_failures
outbox.handlers: idempotent by dedupe key and current target state

retryRecoveryCommand.action: requeue the exact deterministic job or reconciliation operation
retryRecoveryCommand.postSuccessState: recompute waiting_for_human, ready_to_archive or running from current facts
retryRecoveryCommand.nonRecoverableInvariant: reject until an external repair changes the incident subject

reconciliationInvariants: at most one nonterminal governance Attempt per Workflow
a nonterminal governance Attempt has exactly one matching Run and WorkflowAttemptClaim
a queued Run has a dispatch outbox and has never started
a completed Run has a full result snapshot before Attempt finalization
a succeeded Attempt has no staged effects and all declared effects are published
a failed/cancelled/superseded Attempt has no effective staged effects
a terminal Attempt owns no WorkflowAttemptClaim
at most one nonterminal Diagnostic Run and matching claim per Requirement
Workflow archived has no active claim, nonterminal Task/Attempt/Run, open gate or pending outbox
Readiness is evaluated only with no active governance claim and no staged effect
